description: Medium Resolution Digital Elevation Model From Natural Resources Canada’s CanElevation Series (MRDEM-30) is a data set described in the paper "Medium Resolution Digital Elevation Model From Natural Resources Canada’s CanElevation Series (MRDEM-30)" in IEEE Data Descriptions (IEEE, 2025), produced by H. McGrath, C. Papasodoro, J. S. Moreau and colleagues. Elevation data are a core theme provided by the Natural Resources Canada (NRCan) to Canadians as essential geographic information. Elevation data are a fundamental input for many types of studies and applications and also serve as a basemap for national maps and tile sets. The previous national medium resolution terrain and surface data have not been updated by NRCan since 2011. Coverage: Canada, at 30 m resolution. The data are held at the linked repository, and the catalogue links the data set first and the paper second; nothing was downloaded, so the file formats and size are not checked. Licence: not stated (data set page not opened on 2026-10-01). Cost: no charge is stated in the metadata read; the paper's own access terms were not checked. Caveats: written from the paper's abstract and metadata only, so contents, quality and current availability are unchecked and the description may lag the source. It can support flood inundation, hazard exposure and terrain analysis. Related record: the journal-level record for IEEE Data Descriptions.
